title: Compact Immutable WOFOST Rate Table Qualification Evidence
qualified_semantics: active knots are private compact x/y arrays
x <= first knot clamps to first y
x >= last active knot clamps to last y
interior interpolation preserves the legacy B1.10 arithmetic order
single active knot yields a constant table
decreasing-x parser sentinel and unused fixed-array tail are not part of production storage
construction is fail closed for invalid active knots
there is no public post-construction table mutator
table objects are intended as shareable immutable parameter data rather than per-column dynamic state

reference_equivalence.full_legacy_table: bitwise for tested below-range, exact-knot, interior and above-range queries
reference_equivalence.partial_legacy_table_with_sentinel: bitwise for the same tested queries after active-knot compaction
reference_equivalence.claim_boundary: qualification covers AFGEN functional semantics, not an external legacy parser adapter

next_required_production_seam: restricted shared immutable WOFOST rate parameter bundle
